artworks.title: Descente dans les Ateliers de la Liberté de la presse (Raid on the Workshops of the Freedom of the Press)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people in a busy room engaged in various activities. In the center, a woman in a light-colored dress is being held by two men. Surrounding them are men in dark suits, some with hats. On the left, one man appears to be restraining another person seated. On the right, a group of men in hats and jackets are gathered around a press labeled "PRESSE PATRIOTIQUE." Some men hold rods or batons. The scene takes place inside a room with tall windows, papers hanging from above, and printed sheets and a fallen printing frame on the floor. Shelves with books are visible in the background.

artworks.title: The Symposium
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with figures in a classical setting. The drawing depicts a gathering of figures in an interior space that resembles an ancient Roman or Greek setting. One figure on the left appears to be holding a wreath or a leafy object above its head, while others are gathered around a central figure. The setting includes architectural details like columns, a circular wall embellishment, and ornate vases in the foreground. Shadows are used to enhance the depth and texture of the image. The drawing captures a moment of interaction between the figures.

artworks.title: A Rocky Landscape with the Temptation of Christ
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a scene from an elevated viewpoint of a sunken area with a wooden bridge crossing two wooded sections. The brushwork is detailed, showing texture in the trees, bridge, and leaves. The horizon is at the top of the image, with a winding path curving behind the bridge. The color palette is gray, typical of a monochrome etching, emphasizing depth and detail. Gnarled trees with swirling branches frame the scene, while the pathway leads to a rocky landscape in the distance. The image focuses on texture and form rather than color.

artworks.title: Study for Figure of Fame
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and brown wash with white heightening; (group of putti) black chalk with white heightening
artworks.creditLine: Gift of David Edward Rust
artworks.description: The image depicts a winged figure in a dynamic pose, with both arms raised and slightly bent. The figure's facial features are delicately drawn with a serene expression and styled hair in an updo. The figure is draped in flowing garments, enhancing the sense of movement. In each hand, the figure holds a long trumpet-like object, and delicate wings can be seen extending behind. The background is a textured, smudged surface with blue tones, and faint outlines of two cherubic figures can be seen hovering above. The image is framed with a simple border.

artworks.title: Lot and His Daughters
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts three individuals situated prominently in the foreground. The central figure is an older man with a long beard and a receding hairline, draped in loose, flowing robes. To his right, there is a young woman seated, her hair tied back and wearing a gown with wide, exposed shoulders. Positioned behind the man, another young woman stands, leaning over him with an attentive expression. She has curly hair pulled back and wears a similar outfit. The setting features two jugs and a loaf of bread on a small table. The background shows an intricately etched depiction of mountainous terrain or caves, with a faint outline of distant buildings.

artworks.title: Lot and His Daughters
artworks.artist: Joseph-Marie Vien after Jean François de Troy
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: Three individuals are depicted in the image. The person in the middle has a bare chest, a beard, and long hair, while the two individuals on either side are draped in cloth. One of them is reclined with her arm over the man's knee, and the other is pouring from a jug. The background shows a detailed natural setting with rocks, trees, pack animals, and scattered objects like baskets and bottles.

artworks.title: Allegorical Portrait of Pierre Buirette de Belloy
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in the foreground and a child in the lower part. One figure with wings is reclining on clouds, holding a laurel wreath and an oval medallion containing a detailed profile of a person's head. The other central figure stands beside the cloud. This figure is clothed in flowing drapery and extends a hand towards the medallion. Below them, a small child appears holding a shield decorated with fleur-de-lis motifs while a dog reclines next to the child. The background features an architectural structure with engraved images of several people in a classical scene, set against swirling clouds. The composition is rendered in a monochromatic style.

artworks.title: Baccio Bandinelli
artworks.artist: Nicolò della Casa, after Baccio Bandinelli
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man seated, turned slightly sideways with a serious expression. He has a beard, wrinkles on his forehead, and wears a hat and draped robe. He is sculpting a small, detailed nude figure, with another statuette on a platform beside him. In the background, there is a plain wall with a window featuring more small sculptures. The window frame is inscribed with "BACCIO BANDINELLI FLO".

artworks.title: Aeneas and the Sibyl
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 20.2 × 15.6 cm (7 15/16 × 6 1/8 in.), cut to platemark
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals. The person on the left stands, slightly leaning forward, wearing a detailed helmet with a plumed crest. They have classical facial features and long hair peeking from the helmet. The individual wears a tunic, cloak, and sandals. Facing them is another individual in layered clothing and a cloak. They are holding a branch or staff. The background includes trees and a third character reclining against a large amphora from which water flows.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Stream and an Ancient Tree
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 13.7 × 18.1 cm (5 3/8 × 7 1/8 in.) cut to platemark
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with trees, sky, and clouds. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, providing a view of the trees and the vast land ahead. A detailed tree is on the right, while a group of slender trees is on the left. The sky is expansive and adorned with fine, linear clouds. The artwork is monochromatic in black, gray, and white, showcasing intricate line work and textures. The overall composition is balanced.

artworks.title: Valley in the Italian Campagna
artworks.medium: gray and greenish wash over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape seen from a slightly elevated position on a hillside. The horizon is low, emphasizing the sky and distant mountains. The color palette is monochrome with varying shades of grey. The brushstrokes are loose and fluid, depicting foliage and the terrain with movement and texture. A large tree fills the left side, rocks and bushes are scattered in the middle ground, and distant hills and mountains lead the eye into the distance.

artworks.title: Fort Snelling
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Betsy S. Aubrey and E. Steve Lichtenberg, MD
artworks.description: The image shows a body of water with a tree-covered hill in the background. Some buildings are visible at the top of the hill, arranged in a fort-like manner. A bridge extends from the hill, crossing over the water. The image has a cool blue color palette, creating a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: From Wagon Road at S. St. Paul, Minn. Looking Downstream
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Betsy S. Aubrey and E. Steve Lichtenberg, MD
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a river. The horizon, marked by a line of trees, is at the top. In the foreground, there is shrubbery and rocks by the river. A utility pole is prominently placed, leading the eye towards the distant shoreline. The photo uses a cyanotype technique, giving it a blue monochrome color scheme. In the distance, a structure with smoke rising is visible.

artworks.title: From Bluffs at Merrimac, Minn. Looking Downstream
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Betsy S. Aubrey and E. Steve Lichtenberg, MD
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a river meandering through the scene. The viewpoint seems elevated, showing a panoramic view. The river meets the land at the horizon, surrounded by distant tree silhouettes. A path runs alongside a descending slope towards the river, lined with sparse trees and a fence. The image is in a photographic style with a blue hue, as it is a cyanotype print. The serene atmosphere is enhanced by the single color tone.

artworks.title: From Foot of Robinson's Rock Looking Upstream
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Betsy S. Aubrey and E. Steve Lichtenberg, MD
artworks.description: This image depicts a landscape captured from an elevated point of view. A body of water is visible, framed by a riverbank with trees and shrubbery. In the background, a line of distant trees marks the horizon, blending into the sky and land. The image has a cool, monochromatic color palette dominated by blue tones, giving a serene appearance. Details of foliage and water gently merge, and the circular shape adds a vintage vignette effect.

artworks.title: From Foot of Robinson's Rock Looking Upstream
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Betsy S. Aubrey and E. Steve Lichtenberg, MD
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside scene with an elevated perspective. The horizon meets a distant treeline, and a river flows on the left side. A grassy embankment with sparse trees is on the right side. The color palette is predominantly blue, creating a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Redwing, Minn. and Barnbluff
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Betsy S. Aubrey and E. Steve Lichtenberg, MD
artworks.description: The image shows a body of water extending towards a distant shore with buildings lining the horizon. A hill rises prominently on the left side, above the structures. The style is photographic, resembling a cyanotype print in shades of blue. The foreground water is rippled, contrasting with the static buildings. The color palette is predominantly blue, creating a serene effect. The hill and buildings guide the eye across the horizon, with a soft blue sky above.

artworks.title: Read's Landing, Minn.
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Betsy S. Aubrey and E. Steve Lichtenberg, MD
artworks.description: The image shows a body of water with a distant shore. The horizon is in the middle with hills in the background. The photo is in a cyanotype style, giving it a blue color scheme. Ripples are visible close to the viewer. A town is situated along the shore with hills behind. A bridge connects the landmasses in the distance. The sky is clear with a lighter tone than the water. The color palette is predominantly blue, creating a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Alma, Wis.
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Betsy S. Aubrey and E. Steve Lichtenberg, MD
artworks.description: The image depicts a view from the shoreline looking parallel to the coast towards a small town. The horizon aligns with the distant hills that rise gently on the left and more steeply on the right. The photograph is a monochromatic cyanotype print with a color palette of varying shades of blue. Debris can be seen scattered along the sandy shore, possibly fallen trees or driftwood. In the distance, a quaint town stretches along the water's edge with small structures nestled against the base of the hills.

artworks.title: Minneiska, Minn.
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Betsy S. Aubrey and E. Steve Lichtenberg, MD
artworks.description: The image displays a town near a body of water, with a hill in the background. The scene has a cyanotype effect, giving it a blue monochrome palette. Buildings are visible along the water's edge, and a hill covered in trees is on the left.

artworks.title: Fountain City, Wis.
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Betsy S. Aubrey and E. Steve Lichtenberg, MD
artworks.description: The image shows a cyanotype of a riverside scene with a view across the water. The horizon is high in the image, with hills and a small town at their base. Buildings are visible along the riverbank, extending into the distance. The hills are lush with vegetation. The cyanotype color scheme gives a calm feel. The water reflects the scene subtly. The overall color palette is blue due to the cyanotype process. The technique provides a photographic impression with diffuse detail.

artworks.title: Trempealeau, Wis.
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Betsy S. Aubrey and E. Steve Lichtenberg, MD
artworks.description: The image is a cyanotype photograph featuring a view across a calm river towards a small town. The buildings extend along the water's edge, with a hill and lush greenery in the background. The river flows to the left, disappearing into the horizon, which becomes more narrow and indistinct. Trees on the right add depth to the scene. The color palette is monochromatic blue, typical of cyanotypes, giving the scene a serene and ethereal visual impact.

artworks.title: Dakota, Minn.
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Betsy S. Aubrey and E. Steve Lichtenberg, MD
artworks.description: The image shows a low vantage point looking across a body of water towards the opposite shore. The horizon is in the middle of the view, with a small townscape featuring buildings and a prominent steeple above the tree line. Trees on both sides frame the scene, with clusters in the middle and towards the edges. The image is a cyanotype, giving it blue tones. The water nearby reflects the sky subtly. Various shades of blue create depth and detail, with rolling hills in the distance against the lighter sky.

artworks.title: Levee at La Crosse, Wis.
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Betsy S. Aubrey and E. Steve Lichtenberg, MD
artworks.description: The image shows a view across a body of water towards a busy industrial area on the opposite shore. The horizon line is situated about one third from the top, where the water meets the shore. An urban landscape stretches across the scene, with a bridge extending from the left towards the distant buildings on the right. The photo is in a cyanotype style, with blue and white tones creating a monochromatic effect. The color palette ranges from lighter blues on the water's surface to darker hues merging with the sky at the top. The buildings in the distance, including smokestacks and various structures, contrast sharply with the blurred water in the foreground.
